current_parent_critical_path.objective: Research, define, implement and qualify the Book-parent version and rollback boundary so canonical Book objects, manuscript mutations, author decisions, admitted integration outcomes and release-relevant state use immutable version identities with predecessor lineage, exact digests, concurrency-safe pointer advancement and evidence-preserving rollback/recovery rather than in-place historical mutation.
current_parent_critical_path.first_action: Forensically map current version/digest/pointer/rollback semantics already present in the Canonical Book State Model, Lifecycle Transition Engine, Runtime V2, authoring lifecycle contract and artifact/export boundaries; then perform bounded current external research on immutable version lineage, optimistic concurrency, append-only recovery and rollback safety. Classify KEEP / ADD_OR_REFINE / DO_NOT_ADD / UNRESOLVED before changing executable semantics.
must_include: immutable successor identity for every canonical Book object whose accepted content or governing state changes
predecessor and lineage references sufficient to reconstruct the accepted version chain
exact content/state digest binding and fail-closed digest mismatch behavior
optimistic-concurrency or equivalent exact-current-version preconditions for pointer advancement
atomic creation of successor version plus pointer movement, with no in-place mutation of historical versions
rollback as creation/selection of an explicitly identified prior or recovery successor state rather than deletion or rewriting of history
dependency-aware invalidation/revalidation when rollback changes canon, story bible, plan, manuscript, research, arc or setup/payoff dependencies
preservation of integration proposal, author-decision, provenance, artifact and qualification evidence even when current pointers roll back
explicit rules for stale provider responses and stale artifacts after rollback or restoration
author authority preservation: rollback cannot synthesize an approval that did not exist for the selected content/state
publication/export preservation: technical artifact PASS or prior publication state cannot silently authorize a new/rolled-back release
deterministic adversarial fixtures for concurrent updates, stale writes, partial failure, rollback, re-forward, branch-like divergence, digest mismatch and recovery
hosted prequalification and a separately registered exact-SHA A-01 qualification for any changed executable subject
implementation_constraints: Reuse the qualified canonical state, lifecycle and Runtime V2 authorities where their existing semantics are sufficient; do not rebuild them as parallel engines.
Do not transfer Runtime V2, Lifecycle v1, State Model or Registry qualification to changed Version/Rollback bytes.

Do not turn Book System into a generic source-control product or full event-sourcing platform unless research demonstrates a Book-specific requirement that existing append-only ledgers cannot satisfy.
Do not delete historical manuscript, author-decision, proposal, evidence, artifact or receipt versions to make rollback appear clean.
Do not absorb Prose child state/version authority; Book may bind exact Prose outputs as evidence/artifacts only through registered interfaces.
Do not implement document rendering/conversion mechanics inside Book System.
Do not infer author approval, publication authority or production authority from a rollback operation.
current_parent_critical_path.pass_proves: The exact qualified Book Version/Rollback implementation provides immutable, digest-bound, concurrency-safe version lineage and evidence-preserving rollback/recovery for the bounded Book-parent state it owns, without permitting stale writes, hidden history mutation or authority fabrication.
current_parent_critical_path.pass_unlocks: The next dependency-valid Book parent objective selected after a fresh obligation/expectation review; no later objective is pre-declared complete by this state.
current_parent_critical_path.on_failure: Preserve every completed forensic/research/contract/test phase, classify the exact failed versioning/rollback boundary, repair only that boundary on a new exact SHA when bytes change, and do not weaken existing qualified parent authorities or delete history to obtain PASS.

generic_continue_rule: In Book System control, Continue executes BOOK-SYSTEM-VERSION-AND-ROLLBACK-001 beginning with the forensic existing-semantics map and bounded research gate before executable changes.
